positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
A Facebook-like app that mimics a baby memory book in function.

- Architectured and designed the frontend and backend for an original concept
- Allowed user to upload images which would store in an AWS S3 cloud

positions.title: Back End Engineer
positions.description:
A scaled microservice that handles high-volume traffic to display product data as part of an Amazon product page clone.

- Extensively stress-tested read and write operations on 15 million record database to maximize performance
- Horizontally scaled microservice across AWS EC2 micro instances with a load balancer to handle 500 RPS

positions.title: Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
A micro-service that displayed all functionalities of the SoundCloud comment's section. This was a part of a larger web application clone of SoundCloud's track player page.

- Designed pixel-perfect clone using Vue and CSV
- Deployed a proxy-server to AWS to integrate team's microservices
